caption:
Thanksgiving's coming and the oven's about to work overtime. 🦃

If something catches fire in the oven or broiler, keep the door shut and turn off the heat to smother it, then call 911 (U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission).

Cooking is, by far, the leading cause of home fires and home fire injuries (U.S. Fire Administration).

Share this with your community.

#ovenfire #thanksgiving #cookingsafety #firesafety #firedepartment #stationhq
title: ovenfire

caption:
Cold mornings are here. 🚗

Never leave a car running in an attached garage, even with the garage door open. Put CO alarms on every level of the home and outside sleeping areas.

Carbon monoxide is colorless and odorless, and early symptoms feel like the flu without the fever (U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission).

Share this with your community.

#carbonmonoxide #coalarm #wintersafety #firesafety #firedepartment #stationhq
title: warmup

caption:
Furnace kicking on for the season? 🔥

Have heating equipment and chimneys cleaned and inspected every year by a professional, keep anything that can burn at least 3 feet from heat sources, and never use an oven to heat your home.

Heating is the second leading cause of home fires, with about 32,200 reported in 2021 (U.S. Fire Administration).

Share this with your community.

caption:
Same chair, same flame, two fabrics. Left: untreated cotton. Right: a back-coated fabric developed by NIST researchers.

One self-extinguishes the moment the flame is pulled. The other keeps going. 🔥

Upholstered furniture is the leading first item ignited in deadly US home fires.

🎥 Video: NIST (National Institute of Standards and Technology), public domain
🎵 "Hustle" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), CC BY 4.0

title: Untreated vs. treated fabric

caption:
Watered tree on the left. Dry tree on the right. Same ignition source. 🎄🔥

In NIST's test, the watered tree never caught. The dry one was fully involved in seconds and took the room with it.

Remind your community: water the tree every day.

🎥 Video: NIST (National Institute of Standards and Technology), public domain
🎵 "Investigations" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), CC BY 4.0

title: Watered tree vs. dry tree

caption:
7th floor, wind blowing straight into the fire apartment. 🌬️🔥

From the NIST and FDNY wind-driven fire experiments on Governors Island, NY, where researchers tested tactics like wind control devices to stop wind from pushing fire down the hall.

High-rise crews, what's your SOP on wind?
